accept.name: SWE-agent
accept.userValue: Active open-source software-engineering agent and research platform for resolving repository issues, evaluating agent behavior and generating training trajectories.
accept.description: Open-source software-engineering agent for resolving repository issues, evaluation and agent research.
accept.useCase: For researchers and developers experimenting with autonomous code changes, SWE-bench-style tasks and reproducible software-agent workflows.

accept.name: Goose
accept.userValue: Active open-source general-purpose local agent now governed under the Agentic AI Foundation, with desktop, CLI and API surfaces plus MCP and ACP interoperability.
accept.description: Open-source local agent with desktop, CLI and API interfaces plus MCP and ACP integrations.
accept.useCase: For developers who want a vendor-neutral local agent for coding, research, automation and tool-connected workflows.

accept.name: JetBrains Junie
accept.userValue: JetBrains' active coding agent for terminal and IDE workflows, with project-aware planning, debugging, review and multi-model support.
accept.description: JetBrains coding agent for terminal and IDE workflows with project-aware planning, debugging and review.
accept.useCase: For JetBrains users who want to delegate multi-step implementation work while keeping the agent connected to IDE project context and tools.

accept.name: IBM watsonx Code Assistant
accept.userValue: Actively maintained IBM enterprise coding assistant for code generation, explanation, transformation and modernization in governed software-development environments.
accept.description: IBM enterprise coding assistant for generation, explanation, transformation and application modernization.
accept.useCase: For organizations that need AI coding help inside governed enterprise environments, including modernization of existing application estates.

accept.name: ScrapeGraphAI
accept.userValue: Actively developed AI web-data platform for scraping, natural-language structured extraction, search, crawling, monitoring and agent integrations through APIs and MCP.
accept.description: AI web-data platform for scraping, structured extraction, search, crawling and monitoring.
accept.useCase: For developers who want LLM-ready or schema-constrained web data without maintaining selectors and custom parsers for every site.

accept.name: Zyte
accept.userValue: Active web-data extraction platform combining browser infrastructure, anti-blocking and AI extraction for structured page data without hand-written parsers.
accept.description: Web-data extraction platform with browser infrastructure, anti-blocking and AI-powered structured extraction.
accept.useCase: For teams collecting web data at scale that want managed access, rendering and extraction instead of operating a full scraping stack.

accept.name: Stagehand
accept.userValue: Actively developed open-source SDK from Browserbase for browser agents, combining natural-language actions with deterministic automation, self-healing behavior and current v4 agent infrastructure.
accept.description: Open-source SDK for browser agents that combines natural-language actions with deterministic browser automation.
accept.useCase: For developers building browser agents that need more resilience than selector-only automation while retaining code-level control.

accept.name: Jina AI Reader
accept.userValue: Active Jina Reader and Search API service for converting public webpages into LLM-friendly content, web search results and MCP-accessible context.
accept.description: Web reader and search APIs for converting public pages into LLM-friendly content and agent context.
accept.useCase: For developers feeding cleaner web content into research, RAG, search and agent workflows with minimal retrieval plumbing.

accept.name: Unstructured
accept.userValue: Active document-processing platform and open-source ecosystem for parsing, partitioning and transforming complex files into structured inputs for retrieval and AI pipelines.
accept.description: Document-processing platform for parsing and transforming complex files into structured AI-ready data.
accept.useCase: For developers preparing PDFs, office documents and other unstructured files for RAG, search and knowledge systems.

accept.name: Skyvern
accept.userValue: Actively developed AI browser-automation and agentic process automation platform for authenticated, visual and multi-step workflows across websites without brittle selectors.
accept.description: AI browser-automation platform for authenticated, visual and multi-step workflows across websites.
accept.useCase: For operations and development teams automating portal work, extraction, form filling and browser tasks that lack reliable APIs.

remove.name: GitHub Spark
remove.reason: GitHub officially deprecated Spark on August 31, 2026 after stopping new-user access and new app creation on August 4, so it no longer meets the active-product quality gate.
